title: Grateful Dead Live at Feyline Field on 1973-11-25
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording praised for its great, smoky sound; reviewers rave about the audio upgrades.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give five‑star ratings, thanking “Charlie” for the beautiful sound upgrades and calling the show a “smokin’” experience with great sound. While no specific musical moments are mentioned, the high praise for the audio quality suggests the recording is clear and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are five‑star and highlight superb sound quality, but they provide no detail on performance or setlist, limiting the ability to fully assess show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers specifically note “great sound” and thank Charlie for audio upgrades, indicating a clear, well‑balanced recording.
